REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.
FRONT YARD PAVING AND SURFACING:
For any one family dwelling, semi-detached, duplex dwelling, double duplex dwelling, row dwelling or multiple dwelling containing a
maximum of four (4) dwelling units, not more than 50 per cent (50%) of the total surface area of the required front yard shall be covered
with any one (1) of or combination of the following: paving block; brick; concrete; asphalt; construction grade aggregate or any similar
material.
EAVES
Eaves may extend a maximum of 0.6 metres into a required yard unless the required yard is less than 1.2 metres in width in which case
the maximum eave projection shall be 0.3 metres;
ELECTRICAL PERMITS
All Electrical Installations must be inspected by the Electrical Safety Authority. Separate Inspection Applications must be filed.
For more information please call: Electrical Safety Authority: 1-877-ESA-SAFE (1-877-372-7233)
PROTECTION FROM BACKFLOW
Protection from backflow shall be installed for every dwelling unit in accordance with Ontario Building Code, Division B, Section 7.4.6.4
and the referenced CAN/CSA standards. The BWV shall be located within the dwelling unit and be accessible for inspection and
maintenance purposes.
NEW FURNACES
All new furnaces must be equipped with an electronically commutated motor and must be designed to CSA-F280-2012.
MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF HOT WATER
The maximum temperature of hot water supplied by fittings to fixtures in a residential occupancy shall not exceed 49oC. The maximum
temperature does not apply to the hot water supplied to installed dishwashers or clothes washers. (O.B.C. 7.6.5.1)
DECKS, PORCHES & STEPS
The following encroachments are permitted into a yard for decks, porches and steps as specified by the Zoning By-law 8600, as
amended.
1. DECK means a structure having a floor, open to the sky, and a supporting structure below. It may include perimeter guardrails,
fixed seating and vertical visual screening. A patio or terrace is a deck.
a. for a deck having a floor height of 0.3 metres or less above ground into any required yard, without restriction;
b. for a deck or that part thereof having a floor height of greater than 0.3 metres and less than 1.2 metres above the
ground
i. into a required front yard, a maximum of 2.5 metres;
ii. into a required side yard or required rear yard;
iii. not within 1.2 metres of a any lot line;
c. for a deck or part thereof having a floor height of greater than 1.2 metres above the ground
i. into any front or required rear yard, a maximum of 2.5 metres;
ii. not within 1.2 metres of a front or rear lot line;
iii. a minimum separation from each side lot line, equal to the minimum side yard width(s) required within the
zoning district in which the lot is located;
2. PORCH means a structure, with a floor and a fixed roof directly above, primarily intended to provide sheltered access to a
building. It may include perimeter guardrails, a door, seasonal screens or windows
a. for a porch,
i. into any front or required rear yard, a maximum of 2.5 metres;
ii. not within 1.2 metres of a front or rear lot line;
iii. a minimum separation from each side lot line, equal to the minimum side yard width(s) required within the
zoning district in which the lot is located;
3. STEPS
a. for steps having a maximum height of 0.3 metres above the ground, into any side yard or required front or rear yard,
without restriction:
b. for steps having a height of greater than 0.3 metres above the ground
i. into any side yard or required front or rear yard, but not within 1.2 metres of a lot line;
ii. the steps shall have a maximum total tread area of 5.0 square metres within a required yard;-
GROUND means the average elevation of the ground within 3.0 metres of the main building on the lot.
REQUIRED means mandated by the Zoning By-law 8600.
